title: Why am I being charged a fee on my Lime Green Account?
summary: This document explains common fees on a Lime Green Account and when they are charged: a $25 monthly maintenance fee if your balance is below $15,000, $10 outgoing domestic wire fees, $25 outgoing international wire fees, $1 non‑Rho ATM (U.S.) fees, and foreign ATM fees of 1.5% (min $2.50). It also provides how to confirm which fee was charged and steps to avoid or reduce them.
faqs: What monthly maintenance fee might I see on my Lime Green Account, and how do I avoid it?
